verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a Full Export with optional scheduled automated full exports. The exports are open formats: properties become Markdown front matter and collections become CSV files, described as human- and machine-readable for reuse in other apps. That covers exporting everything in open formats and leaving. The evidence is first-party docs only, and the Notion/Evernote migration docs describe importing into Capacities, not exporting out, so they are not credited. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete export, explicit evidence that media files and links/backlinks are preserved in the export.
